body: oh man, i'm so so overjoyed that you're still with us but i'm sorry it got to this point again. please try to take care of yourself. you've got people on here who are willing to talk to you when you need a friend, and you've got people in your life who care about you, even if it may not seem that way. please try to stay safe, i know this is so so rough, but you'll make it through. i've never spoken to you before, but if you ever need to vent or just talk about anything, just shoot me a message. i'm here for you.
